import bpy, json
expected=r'C:\mcp-blender\salvador_lacerda_do_zero.blend'
if bpy.data.filepath.lower()!=expected.lower(): raise RuntimeError('arquivo errado')
for name in ['Lacerda | torre externa - implantacao OSM','Entrada superior Lacerda | identificacao por confronto fotografico']:
 o=bpy.data.objects.get(name)
 print('ANCHOR',name,'EXISTS',bool(o))
 if not o: continue
 print(' TYPE',o.type,'LOC',tuple(round(x,6) for x in o.location),'DIMS',tuple(round(x,6) for x in o.dimensions),'ROT',tuple(round(x,6) for x in o.rotation_euler))
 print(' COLLECTIONS',[c.name for c in o.users_collection])
 print(' CUSTOM_PROPS',json.dumps({k:o[k] for k in o.keys() if k!='_RNA_UI'},ensure_ascii=False,default=str))
 if o.type=='MESH': print(' VERTS',len(o.data.vertices),'POLYS',len(o.data.polygons))
print('ANCHOR_METADATA_DONE')
